callerIds.description:
The numbers the user may call from: their direct lines first, then
shared lines, then the main line.

defaultNumberId.description:
The one to preselect: the user's chosen default while it is still
theirs, else their first direct line, else the first one; null when
they may call from none.

items.description:
Calls in the `CloudTalk` shape (`Cdr`, `Contact`, `Agent`, …). A
`telnyx` call's `Cdr.id` and `Cdr.recording_link` are `tx_<call id>`
(for `POST /v1/call-transcripts` and the recording route; the link
is empty when not recorded), times are RFC 3339 UTC, `Agent` is the
user who placed or answered it, `CallNumber.internal_name` our
number's label, and a `Telnyx` part adds `call_id`, `status`
(`answered`, `missed`, `voicemail`, `ai_message`, `declined`,
`busy`, `no_answer`, `failed`, `canceled`), `line_label`,
`our_number`, `customer_id`, `deal_id`, `transcript_status`,
`ai_note` (null until written), `note_added` (the AI note is on the
deal), `via_cell`, `spam_likely` and `may_hear`: false when the
caller may not hear the call (only its user, the users of its direct
line, for an unanswered incoming call the users its line rings, its
deal's owner, admins and sales managers may), and then `recorded` is
false, `recording_link` empty and `ai_note` null. A `CloudTalk` or
`RingCentral` call has `provider`: the one that carried it.

conversion_percent.description: Won out of closed, in percent; null with no closed deals.

notify_customer.description: Email the signer that the request was cancelled (default false).

Cancelled.description: A cancelled request, when the customer was to be told.

customer_notified.description: False when the email to the customer could not be sent.

last4.description: Last four digits of the card number.

email.description: The primary email (else the oldest one); null when none.

repName.description: The sales rep's name; null when unassigned.

address.description: Street, city, state and ZIP on one line; null when none.

CardContact.description: The contact card's customer: the index fields and more.

CardDeal.description: A deal on the contact card.

amount.description: Its amount, as a decimal string (`"1500.25"`); null when not set.

oneOf.description: Its newest note; null when it has none.

createdBy.description: Who wrote it (a name); null when unknown.

item.description: The extra (`OtherItem`: name, category, options or per-unit tiers).

code.description: The 6-digit code our call read out.

cellNumber.description: My cell number, US or Canada (E.164 or 10 digits).

Channel.description: How a template reaches the customer.

mode.description:
`instructions` (default), `priceLists` or `assistant`. A question
about the company's records goes to the assistant anyway. The
assistant reads customers, deals and notes: employees only (403 for
others, whose record questions are answered from the instructions).

isNew.description: The first question of a conversation.

oneOf.description: The special order the slabs and delivery in the question are for.

images.description:
Pictures added to the question, as `data:image/…` URLs (at most
[`MAX_IMAGES`]).

oneOf.description: The page the user is on, when they share it.

ChatRole.description: Who wrote a message of the conversation.

Check.description: A check of a piece of equipment; its usage fields override the equipment's.

hours_per_day.description: Own usage per working day; null uses the equipment's.

usage_unit.description: Own unit; null uses the equipment's.

CheckInput.description: Body of creating or saving a check.

maintenance_item_id.description: Its equipment (creating only; ignored when saving).

hours_per_day.description: Own usage per working day; null uses the equipment's.

conditions.description:
At least one; at most one `hours` and one `days`. Saving replaces
the conditions (their counts start over).

Checklist.description:
A post-installation checklist: what the installer checked on site after
installing countertops, signed by the customer.

id.description: Checklist id. Its PDF is served by the web app at `/api/checklist-pdf/{id}`.

customer_id.description:
Customer record the checklist belongs to; null when the installer
typed a name without picking a customer, or the customer was deleted.

customer_name.description: Customer name as written on the checklist.

email.description: Customer email the satisfaction survey goes to; null if not given.

installer_id.description: User id of the installer who filled it in; null if unknown.

installer_name.description:
Installer's name, also for installers who were deleted since; null
when there is no installer.

checks.description: Each item of the checklist, `true` when it passed.

comments.description: Installer's or customer's comments; null or empty when none.

created_at.description: When the checklist was submitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

ChecklistChecks.description:
The items the customer confirms with the installer (labels as on the
form); `true` means it passed.

ChoiceInput.description: An answer of a question being saved.

id.description: An existing answer to keep; omitted for a new one.

text.description: Its text; a blank answer is dropped.

status.description:
`credited`, `already-completed`, `not-done` (open its page instead) or
`unavailable` (guided tours are off).

oneOf.description: The saved state (credited and already-completed).

classes.description: The company's `Class` entities (empty when they could not be read).

closed_at.description: When it left its last stage.

eligible.description:
The caller has a `CloudTalk` line (agent and number), a `RingCentral`
line (extension and number) or a Granite Phone number (calling
switched on for the company).

CoachingCall.description: A call the coach can score.

call_id.description:
`CloudTalk` or `RingCentral` call id, or `tx_<id>` for a Granite Phone
call.

started_at.description:
When it started (`CloudTalk` time, or RFC 3339 for `RingCentral` and
Granite Phone).

customer_name.description: The customer, from the CRM or the phone system.

error_message.description: Why it could not be scored.

CommissionPart.description: One rule's share of a quote's commission.

base.description: What it was applied to: dollars, sq ft or units.

note.description: Where it applied, e.g. the area or the line.

payrollDate.description: The payroll it is paid with (YYYY-MM-DD).

applies.description:
`material` (the stone per area), `quote` (the whole quote before
tax), `lines` (price lines matching `lineMatch`) or `monthly_goal`.

rateType.description: `percent` or `flat` (dollars per sq ft, unit, quote or goal).

stop.description: Material rules: a match keeps lower rules from paying on the same area.

materials.description: Material rules: only these materials (empty: any).

colors.description: Material rules: only these colors (empty: any).

lineMatch.description: Line rules: text the line's key or description contains.

threshold.description: Monthly goals: the month's paid sales that earn the bonus.

baseWeekly.description: Paid every payroll week on top of commissions (not negative).

payrollWeekday.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday: the day payroll goes out.

weeks.description: Paychecks per payroll date, newest first.

CompanyDetails.description: A company's settings as super admins edit them.

logo_height.description: Logo height in pixels as saved, or null.

sales_tax_percent.description: Sales tax in percent, or null.

ringcentral_client_id.description: `RingCentral` JWT app client id, or null.

ringcentral_client_secret.description: `RingCentral` JWT app client secret, or null.

signature_enabled.description:
The old company eSignatures switch; no longer used (eSignatures are
given per user).

onboarding_enabled.description: Guided tours switch (own setting, else the platform default).

leaderboard_enabled.description: Points leaderboard switch (own setting, else the platform default).

CompanyFeatures.description:
What the company the request acts in has switched on or set up. Pages use
it to decide which features, widgets and links to offer.

quickbooks_enabled.description:
The QuickBooks feature is switched on for the company (on unless a
platform admin turned it off).

quickbooks_connected.description:
The company has connected a QuickBooks account (OAuth tokens saved).
QuickBooks data is only usable when both this and `quickbooks_enabled`
are true.

onboarding.description:
Guided tours and their points (the company's own switch, else the
platform-wide default).

leaderboard.description:
The points leaderboard (the company's own switch, else the
platform-wide default). See `GET /v1/points-leaderboard`.

e_signature.description:
E-signatures: the company has a SignWell API key. Each user still needs
their own `is_signature_available` flag.

inbound_email.description:
Inbound email is set up (the company has a mail domain): the Emails
inbox and email widgets are offered.

cloudtalk.description: The company has CloudTalk credentials (calls and texts).

ringcentral.description:
The company is connected to RingCentral (OAuth, or JWT credentials).
When both are set up, texts go through RingCentral.

telnyx.description:
Granite Phone is switched on (`telnyx_company_config.enabled`): calls
through Telnyx, and texts from the company's Telnyx numbers.

telnyx_sms.description:
Texting through Telnyx is on: Granite Phone is on and the company's
Telnyx messaging profile is set. Users with a Telnyx line text through
it (`/v1/sms/telnyx/...`).

auto_sale.description:
Marking a deal won or a quote sold opens the sale form, filled from
the quote (Admin › Automations, `PUT /v1/company/auto-sale`).

auto_unscheduled_jobs.description:
Marking a quote sold adds its template and installation to the
schedule's Unscheduled list (Admin › Automations,
`PUT /v1/company/auto-unscheduled-jobs`).

CompanyFrame.description: The frame of a company's pages.

logo_height.description: Logo height in pixels (the app clamps it).

CompanyHours.description: When the company's main line rings: `GET` and `PUT /v1/phone/admin/hours`.

oneOf.description:
The main line's hours (a valid IANA `tz`, at least one range, `HH:MM`
with start before end); null = always.

holidays.description:
Dates the main line rings nobody, `YYYY-MM-DD` in the company time
zone (at most 366; sorted, repeats dropped).

subdomain.description: Subdomain: lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens (required, unique).

max_users.description: User limit (1 or more); edit only.

logo_url.description: A new logo uploaded to `company-logos`; edit only, omit to keep it.

signature_enabled.description:
The old company eSignatures switch; edit only (omit to leave it). No
longer used: eSignatures are given per user.

CompanyRecording.description: Which calls the company records: `GET` and `PUT /v1/phone/admin/recording`.

recordingMode.description:
`off`, `inbound` (incoming calls) or `both` (incoming and outgoing).
Callers hear "This call may be recorded" before it rings.

recordingNoticeUrl.description:
The notice played to the customer on recorded outgoing calls, an
audio file URL (`http(s)://`, at most 512 characters); null or blank
= "This call may be recorded." is said instead.

revenue_generated.description:
Sum of sale prices as a decimal string (e.g. `"1500.00"`), the way
mysql2 returns DECIMAL; null when there are no sales.

CompanyRow.description:
A customer row of the `companies` view, with totals over its own sales
and those of its child customers.

company_id.description: The company these settings are of.

logo_url.description: Logo shown in the header, or null.

logo_height.description: Logo height in pixels as saved (32-192), or null.

sales_tax_percent.description: Sales tax in percent (e.g. 7.25), or null.

can_request_api_token.description:
The caller holds the Manager position in the company (may request the
API bearer token).

logo_url.description:
A new logo uploaded to the `company-logos` folder; omit to keep the
current one.

sales_tax_percent.description: Sales tax in percent (0 to 100); null clears it.

user_count.description: Active users counting toward the limit.

onboarding_finished.description: Users who finished the first-run tour.

billing_required.description: Access depends on the Stripe subscription.

cloudtalk_agent_id.description: `CloudTalk` agent id as saved, or null.

runs_onboarding.description: Runs the guided tours (not an installer or walk-in account).

counts_toward_user_limit.description: Counts toward the user limit (not walk-in only).

onboarding_completed_at.description: When the first-run tour was completed (ISO 8601), or null.

onboarding_started.description: A tours record exists (`progress` is saved, not the empty default).

has_cloudtalk_api.description: The company has `CloudTalk` keys (the tours read it).

notes.description: Notes (with the meter reading when given).

completed_by_name.description: Who did it; null when unknown.

total_hours_of_work.description:
The meter reading now (checks with an hour condition); becomes the
starting reading of the check (if it has its own usage) or of the
equipment.

ComposeTarget.description: Whose thread the composer is in.

customer_email.description: The email recipient, when there is no customer.

deal_id.description: The deal the composer is on.

interval_value.description: Every this many hours or days.

hours_done.description: Hours used since the last time (hour conditions).

ConditionInput.description: A condition of a check being saved.

interval_value.description: Every this many hours or days; more than 0.

channel.description: How it reached the customer: `sms` or `email`.

Connected.description: After connecting: where the company lives.

company_subdomain.description:
The company's subdomain, to go back to its settings there; null when
it has none.

ConnectionStatus.description: What a test call says about a saved connection.

deals.description: Their live deals, open ones first, then newest (at most 20).

calls.description:
The last 20 calls with them (anyone's), newest first; recordings and
AI notes only of the calls the caller may hear.

crmUrl.description: The customer's page in the CRM.

full.description:
True: a full download; replace the phone's copy with this page and
the following ones (`nextAfter`). False: changes to apply.

contacts.description:
Contacts, by id: a page of the full download, or the ones changed,
added or called since the cursor.

deleted.description: Since-sync only: ids of customers deleted since the cursor.

nextAfter.description:
Full download: pass as `?after=` for the next page; null on the last
page (and for a since-sync).

cursor.description:
Pass as `?since=` next time (opaque). Keep the one of a full
download's first page.

coworkers.description:
Coworkers with a direct line (first page and since-sync only; empty
on later pages).

matches.description: One match per number, in the order sent.

ContactsVersion.description:
The contact index on the server, to tell whether the phone's copy is
current.

etag.description:
The index's current ETag (as `GET /v1/phone/contacts/index` sends
it): when it differs from the phone's, sync.

ContentInput.description: Body creating a note or a comment.

content.description: Text (notes up to 5000 characters, comments up to 2000).

url.description: A link that opens it (presigned for stored mail).

body.description: Body as stored (HTML or text).

is_from_customer.description: Sent by the customer, not an employee.

opened_at.description: First time the customer opened it.

body.description: The message (an email's body, without a subject line).

customer_email.description: For an email to someone not on file yet.

phone_digits.description: The SMS thread's phone (5 to 15 digits).

deal_id.description: The deal to focus on.

custom_request.description: What the rep asks for (custom drafts, at most 2000 characters).

previous_draft.description: The draft to revise (at most 8000 characters).

revision_instruction.description: What to change in it (at most 2000 characters).

instruction_history.description: Every instruction so far, oldest first (at most 12).

include_instructions.description: Custom drafts: follow the company's instructions (default true).

ConversionCount.description: Won deals out of all deals of one group.

ConversionMetrics.description: A rep's deals made and sold, by customer source.

sectionId.description: The manual section it belongs to.

proposedManualChange.description: The change it suggests for that section.

Coworker.description:
A coworker the user can call: a user of the company with at least one
phone number.

name.description: Name (the email when the user has none).

e164.description: Their first number (`phones[0]`), E.164; the one to call.

label.description: That number's label; null when empty.

phones.description:
Every number they have, first the Granite Phone direct lines, then
RingCentral, CloudTalk and their own phone; no number twice.

label.description:
What it is: a direct line's own label (null when it has none),
`Work` (their `RingCentral` number), `Office` (their `CloudTalk`
number) or `Mobile` (their own phone). The app never names the provider.

deal_id.description: The open deal of an assigned customer.

CreatedDeal.description: A deal created for the customer.

CreatedId.description: The id of the row just created.

url.description: Photo URL; null when none.

length.description: Length in inches as stored, e.g. "110".

CreatedUser.description: A new user and their invite.

invite_url.description: The invite link, to share another way if the email does not arrive.

email_sent.description: The invite was emailed to them.

CredentialsSource.description: Where the app's credentials come from.

Credit.description: Setup tasks credited by this request.

state.description: The saved state after the credit.

CrewStatus.description: The crew's progress on a job.

oneOf.description:
On my way: how the customer was told just now (`sms` or `email`);
null when nothing went out.

message_error.description: On my way: why the customer was not told, for the crew to read.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number, unique in the company.

customer_id.description: The CRM customer billed; null when the invoice bills someone else.

customer_name.description: That customer's current name in the CRM; null without a customer.

quote_id.description: The quote it was made from; null for an invoice made by hand.

quote_name.description: That quote's name; null without a quote.

due_date.description: Due date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null when due on receipt.

bill_to_email.description: Email it is sent to; null when none.

project_address.description: Job site address; null when none.

subtotal.description: Sum of the line amounts, in dollars.

customer_memo.description: Message to the customer printed on the invoice; null when none.

private_note.description: Internal note, never printed; null when none.

sent_at.description: When it was first sent (ISO 8601, UTC); null while a draft.

paid_at.description: When it was marked paid (ISO 8601, UTC); null unless `paid`.

created_by_name.description: Name of the user who created it; null when unknown.

CustomerDeal.description: A deal of a customer, with a preview of its notes and activities.

status.description: Stage name when the deal last moved.

list_name.description: Name of the deal's current stage.

notes.description: Up to two notes, pinned first, then newest.

activities.description: Up to two activities, unfinished first, then by deadline.

CustomerDetail.description: One customer with contact details, as the customer picker shows it.

email.description: Primary email address; null when the customer has none.

company_name.description: Company name for business customers; null or empty for private ones.

source.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. `leads`, `check-in`, `other`.

your_message.description: Message the customer left when signing up.

sales_rep.description: Assigned sales rep (user id); null when unassigned.

sales_rep_name.description: Name of the assigned sales rep; null when unassigned or deleted.

attached_file.description: File the lead attached to the web form (URL).

invalid_lead.description: Why the lead was marked invalid; null or empty for a valid one.

lead.description: Lead form answers, as the lead sources send them (free text).

CustomerHistory.description:
Everything the customer dialog shows besides the contact details
(`GET /v1/customers/{id}`).

created_by.description: Who created the customer (name), if recorded.

assigned_date.description: When the customer was first assigned to a sales rep.

deleted_at.description: When the customer was deleted; null when live.

parent_id.description: Parent customer (a project of another customer).

first_rep_deal_created_at.description: When the first live deal was created (the lead reached a sales rep).

initial_sales_rep_name.description: Sales rep of that first deal.

deals.description: Live deals in live stages, newest first.

reassignments.description: Reassignments of the customer, oldest first.

created_deals.description: Every deal ever made for the customer, oldest first.

emails.description: Email history (by address and as a participant), newest first.

activities.description: Activities of the live deals, latest first.

notes.description: Notes of the live deals, pinned first, with comments.

emails.description: Every email address, primary first (replaces the saved ones).

oneOf.description: How they heard of the company (create only).

source.description:
Lead source: built in (`check-in`, `leads`, `call-in`, `other`) or one
of the company's sources (1–255 characters).

sales_rep.description: Assigned sales rep (user id), or null.

CustomerOnlineQuote.description: One of a customer's online quotes, as their own page shows it.

doc.description:
The drawing (the quote document, no supplier costs): its `counters`
are the pieces.

prices.description: Each color's total, as on the quote; no breakdown.

CustomerProjects.description: The projects of a customer's family.

parent_id.description: The parent of the family (the customer itself when it has none).

customers.description: The parent and its projects, by name.

CustomerRow.description:
One row of the customers table. Field names match the Remix
`CustomersListCustomer` type exactly, including `customerTemperature`.

email.description:
Primary email address; all addresses come from
`POST /v1/customers/emails/batch`.

sales_rep.description: User id of the assigned sales rep.

assigned_date.description: When the current sales rep was assigned.

sales_rep_name.description: Name of the assigned sales rep; null if unassigned or the rep was deleted.

source.description: Lead source, e.g. a website form or referral.

invalid_lead.description: Reason the lead was marked invalid. Null or empty means valid.

company_name.description: Business name when the customer is a company (contractor, designer...).

customerTemperature.description: Lead temperature: `hot`, `medium` or `cold`; null if not set.

CustomerSale.description: A sale to the customer, as the customer view lists it.

deal_id.description: The deal the sale is part of.

cancelled.description: Unsold (the slabs went back to stock).

CustomerSales.description: A customer's sales to the rep this month.

CustomerSearchRow.description: A customer matching a search, with their latest deal.

deal_id.description: The customer's most recent live deal; null when none.

deal_is_won.description: That deal's outcome: 1 won, 0 lost, null open or no deal.

deal_group_id.description: Board group of that deal's list; null when there is no deal.

label.description: Shown in the dropdown.

is_system.description: Built in: can be renamed but not deleted.

CustomersByRep.description: A rep's valid customers by source.

CustomersPage.description: One page of the customers table.

rows.description: The page's rows, shaped as in `GET /v1/customers`.

emails.description: Every email of the page's customers, primary first, keyed by customer id.

page.description: The page returned: the last one when `page` was past it.

month_rows.description:
For the "this month" counts per sales rep: the tab's customers whose
tab date falls in the current UTC month. Empty in the companies view
and the `other` tab, which show no counts.

CutOptions.description: Body of the cut and uncut operations.

with_remnants.description:
Admins and the shop: on cut, drop the slab's unsold remnants; on
uncut, give the whole size back to its parent and remnants.

CutSlab.description: A cut whole slab with its stone, supplier and sale.

sale_date.description: When it was sold; null when the sale is missing.

seller_name.description: Who sold it; null when unknown.

CutStats.description: Cutting over a range of days.

materials.description: The whole range by material, most first.

id.description: Sale id; its sales order is `GET /v1/sales/{id}/contract`.

customer_id.description: Null for a sale without a customer.

seller_name.description: The sales rep who sold it.

stones.description: Stone colors of its slabs, by name.

sinks.description: Sinks sold with it, by model.

package.description:
The price list of the deal's quote (the signed one, else the newest);
null when the sale's deal has no quote.

price.description: Sale amount, decimal string in USD.

deposit.description:
The deposit its sales order asks for: half of a price over $1,000,

oneOf.description:
The customer's signed contract (the one of the sale's deal first,

DashboardLayout.description: The signed-in user's dashboard layout in the company the request acts in.

widget_ids.description:
Widgets in screen order. Empty when the user never saved a layout in
this company (show the default widgets) or removed every widget.

A widget of the employee dashboard. Must match `EmployeeDashboardWidgetId`

home_address.description: The company address the route starts from.

stops.description: Where each asked stop is, in order; null where it cannot be found.

route.description:

How many of the signed-in user's deals were won, overall and by how the

name.description: Color or product name as the list writes it.

unit.description:
`sqft` or `slab`. A price over $250 is per slab (no stone costs that
a square foot), with or without a size; a smaller one is per slab
when the list says so, unless the slab's size makes that under $5 a
square foot.

slab.description: Slab size in inches, longer side first; null when the list gives none.

file.description: Name of the price file it was read from.

file_id.description:
`supplier_files.id` of that file: one of the searched files the AI
cited (by its SOURCE number, else its exact name); null when it
cited none, so no link is guessed.

url.description: Where that file is stored, to open it; null with `file_id`.
A newly uploaded picture replacing the old one; leave out to keep it.

customer_name.description: The name the customer left; null when they stayed anonymous.

sales_rep_comments.description: What the customer said about the rep.

technician_comments.description: What the customer said about the technician.

installation_comments.description: What the customer said about the installation.

company_name.description: Company name; empty when the company does not exist.

sales_reps.description: The company's sales reps, by name.

customer_name.description:
The customer's name, only if they choose to give it (up to 255
characters); null or blank keeps the answers anonymous.

sales_rep_id.description: The sales rep rated; one of the company's sales reps.

installer_id.description: The installer rated; one of the company's installers.

checklist_id.description:
The checklist of the survey link (`c`), with its signed token (`t`):
recording the completion stops the reminders. The answers are saved
without them, so the survey stays anonymous.

SurveyPerson.description: A person the customer can rate.

sent_by_day.description: Invitations sent per day, oldest first, one entry per day of the range.

waiting_for_send_window.description: Outside the send window: nothing was looked at.

SwitchableCompany.description: A company the super admin may act in.

referral_source.description: How they heard of the company.

TableDeal.description: A deal of the table's customers.

customer_id.description: The customer (else the phone's customer, if any).

version.description: Registry version the progress was recorded against.

step_key.description: The step the user is on.

points_awarded.description: Points it paid (completed tours only, never negative).

closed_at.description: When it was last closed (UTC, ISO 8601): a skip, unless completed since.

state_tax_pct.description: The company's state sales tax in percent; 0 when not set.

users.description: The company's sales reps, by name.

attempts.description: Their answers, by employee, newest try first.

enabled.description: The company's guided tours are on; off, `members` is empty.

TeamCapabilities.description: What the company can do, as the tour registry gates on it.

verified_domain.description: SES has verified the company's mail domain.

followup_tours.description: The follow-up tours are switched on (`FOLLOWUP_ONBOARDING_ENABLED`).

onboarding.description: The company's guided tours are on.

can_manage_users.description: Holds the Manager position (may manage users).

has_sms_line.description:
Has a texting line of their own (`CloudTalk` agent and number, or a
`RingCentral` extension and number).

TelegramLink.description: Body of `POST /v1/me/telegram/{bot}`: what the Telegram login widget returned.

crm_user_id.description: The CRM user the page linked for; must be the caller.

TelegramNumber.description: A Telegram id the widget sends as a number or a string.

TelegramStatus.description: Whether the signed-in user's Telegram is linked to each of the two bots.

leads_linked.description: Linked to the lead alerts bot.

notifications_linked.description: Linked to the CRM notifications bot.

leads_bot_id.description:
Telegram user id of the lead alerts bot, for the Telegram login
widget; null when the bot is not configured.

notifications_bot_id.description: Telegram user id of the notifications bot; null when not configured.

enabled.description: Calling is on: off, no phone of the company can call or ring.

credentialConnectionId.description:
The Telnyx credential connection the phones register on (their
calls come to `{webhookBase}/outbound`); null when not set.

texmlAppId.description:
The TeXML application of the company's numbers (calls come to
`{webhookBase}/inbound`); null when not set.

outboundVoiceProfileId.description: The Telnyx outbound voice profile; null when not set.

billingGroupId.description: The Telnyx billing group; null when not set.

telnyxAccountId.description:
The company's Telnyx account id (Mission Control's account SID, the
`AccountSid` of Telnyx's TeXML requests). When set, every TeXML
request to the company's webhooks must carry it (403 otherwise); null
= not checked.

aiAssistantId.description:
The Telnyx AI Assistant that takes calls nobody answers (numbers
whose no-answer action is `ai`); null = voicemail instead.

fallbackTexmlUrl.description:
Where callers go when our webhook fails (a TeXML Bin with the AI
Assistant, then voicemail); null = `TELNYX_FALLBACK_TEXML_URL`.

recordingNoticeUrl.description:
The notice played to the customer on recorded outgoing calls (an
audio file URL), before the call is bridged; null = "This call may be
recorded." is said to both sides once the customer answers, before
the recording starts.

messagingProfileId.description:
The Telnyx messaging profile the company's numbers text through (its
webhook URL is `{webhookBase}/messaging`); texting is on while calling
is on and this is set; null = no texting through Telnyx.

oneOf.description:
When the main line rings (its `tz` is the company time zone); null =
always.

holidays.description:
Dates the main line rings nobody, `YYYY-MM-DD` in the company time
zone, sorted.

minAppVersion.description:
The oldest app version that may call (e.g. `1.4.0`); null =
`PHONE_MIN_APP_VERSION`.

dailyCallLimit.description: Outgoing calls one user may start per day.

webhookBase.description:
The root of the company's Telnyx webhooks, to paste into Telnyx:
`https://api.../v1/webhooks/telnyx/<token>` (`/inbound` and
`/call-status` on the TeXML app, `/outbound` on the credential
connection). Read-only.

TelnyxConfigInput.description:
Body of `PUT /v1/superuser/companies/{id}/telnyx`: the whole setup (as
`TelnyxCompanyConfig`, without `webhookBase`). Blank text counts as
null.

credentialConnectionId.description: Telnyx credential connection id (at most 64 characters, no spaces).

texmlAppId.description: Telnyx TeXML application id (at most 64 characters, no spaces).

outboundVoiceProfileId.description: Telnyx outbound voice profile id (at most 64 characters, no spaces).

billingGroupId.description: Telnyx billing group id (at most 64 characters, no spaces).

telnyxAccountId.description:
The Telnyx account id (at most 64 characters, no spaces); null or
blank = TeXML requests are not checked for it.

aiAssistantId.description: Telnyx AI Assistant id (at most 128 characters, no spaces).

fallbackTexmlUrl.description: The fallback TeXML URL (`http(s)://`, at most 512 characters).

messagingProfileId.description:
Telnyx messaging profile id (at most 64 characters, no spaces); null
or blank = no texting through Telnyx.

dailyCallLimit.description: 0 to 1,000,000 outgoing calls per user per day.

configured.description:
Calls can ring and be placed: the TeXML app and the credential
connection are set.

created.description:
What Telnyx made this time, of `billingGroup`, `voiceProfile`,
`texmlApp`, `credentialConnection` and `messagingProfile`; empty when
everything was there already and was only pointed at us again.

imported.description: Numbers added from the TeXML app.

oneOf.description: `hot`, `medium`, `cold`, or null to clear.

TemplateAttachment.description: A file sent with every email made from a template.

url.description: File URL.
URL of a file uploaded to the `email-templates` folder.

TemplateOrder.description: The caller's sorting of one picker.

TenDlcActions.description: What the company's Managers may do with the registration now.

edit.description:
Change the form (`PUT`): before it is sent, and after Telnyx refused
it.

markReady.description:
Mark it ready for a superuser (`POST .../ready`): a saved draft, or
one Telnyx refused once it is fixed (`problems` must be empty); not
while its AI check waits or runs.

sendAnyway.description:
Send it to the superusers although the AI check asked for changes
(`POST .../send-anyway`; the AI can be wrong): a complete form whose
check's result is `changes`.

TenDlcAiCheck.description: The AI check of the registration, as the API shows it.

requestedAt.description: When it was asked for (the form was marked ready).

checkedAt.description: When the result came; null before.

summary.description: The result in a few sentences; null before.

unclear.description: What the AI could not verify, for the superusers.

TenDlcAiCheckStatus.description: Where the AI check of a registration is.

TenDlcAiFix.description: One change the AI asks for.

location.description:
What to change: a form field (`campaign.messageFlow`,
`campaign.samples.1`, `campaign.privacyPolicyLink`,
`campaign.termsAndConditionsLink`, `brand.phone`, `brand.email`,
`campaign.other` for a choice on the form) or a page
(`page:quoteForm`, `page:privacyPolicy`, `page:terms`,
`page:website`, and the privacy and terms pages the quote form links
to: `page:linkedPrivacy`, `page:linkedTerms`).

label.description: The field or page, for people ("How customers opt in").

link.description: The page's link; null for a form field.

problem.description: What is wrong and what the carriers require.

current.description:
The text as it is now (the field, or the passage on the page); empty
when the text is missing and must be added.

replacement.description: The text to use instead (or to add).

TenDlcAiUnclear.description:
Something the AI could not verify (a page it could not read): for the
superusers to look at by hand.

label.description: The check ("Opt-in checkbox").

note.description: What could not be verified, and why.

TenDlcBrandDraft.description:
The business behind the texts (the 10DLC brand). Any field may be empty
while a draft; `problems` says what sending needs.

oneOf.description: The form of business; null until chosen.

displayName.description:
The name customers know the business by (DBA), shown to carriers; up
to 100 characters.

companyName.description:
The legal name, exactly as the IRS (or CRA) has it for the tax id;
up to 100 characters.

ein.description:
The tax id: a US EIN (`12-3456789`) or a Canadian business number
(9 digits).

country.description: Where the business and its tax id are registered: `US` or `CA`.

firstName.description: A business contact's first name; may be empty. Up to 100 characters.

lastName.description: A business contact's last name; may be empty. Up to 100 characters.

phone.description:
The business phone, a US or Canada number (saved as E.164 when it is
one).

email.description: The business email carriers may write to; up to 100 characters.

website.description:
The business website (`https://...`), which carriers check; up to
100 characters.

street.description: Street and number of the business address; up to 100 characters.

postalCode.description: ZIP code (`46204`) or Canadian postal code (`K1A 0B1`).

oneOf.description: The industry; null until chosen.

stockSymbol.description: `PUBLIC_PROFIT` only: the stock symbol, up to 10 characters.

oneOf.description: `PUBLIC_PROFIT` only: the stock exchange; null otherwise.

businessContactEmail.description: `PUBLIC_PROFIT` only: the business contact email Telnyx requires.

TenDlcCampaignDraft.description:
How the business texts (the 10DLC campaign). Any field may be empty
while a draft; `problems` says what sending needs.

oneOf.description: What the texts are about; null until chosen.

subUsecases.description:
The kinds of texts of a `MIXED` (2 to 5) or `LOW_VOLUME` (1 to 5)
campaign; empty for the other use cases.

description.description: What the business texts and why, 40 to 4096 characters.

messageFlow.description:
How customers agree to get texts: where they give their number and
what they are told; 40 to 2048 characters.

samples.description:
Example texts, 2 to 5, each 20 to 255 characters, naming the
business and saying how to opt out ("Reply STOP to opt out").

helpMessage.description:
The answer to HELP: names the business and how to reach it; 20 to
255 characters.

helpKeywords.description:
The words that get the help answer, comma separated (`HELP,INFO`);
must include HELP.

optinMessage.description:
The answer to an opt-in word, naming the business; 20 to 255
characters.

optoutMessage.description: The answer to STOP, naming the business; 20 to 255 characters.

optoutKeywords.description: Opt-out words, comma separated; must include STOP.

embeddedLink.description: The texts carry links (needed when a sample has one).

embeddedLinkSample.description:
An example of a link the texts carry; may be empty. Up to 255
characters.

embeddedPhone.description: The texts carry phone numbers (needed when a sample has one).

numberPool.description: The texts go out from a pool of numbers (50 or more).

ageGated.description: The texts are about age-restricted products.

directLending.description: The texts are about direct lending or loans.

optinFormLink.description:
The page with the form customers fill out to give their number and
agree to texts (the quote form), `https://...`; the AI check reads it.
Not sent to Telnyx (the message flow names it).

termsAccepted.description:
The carriers' terms for business texting are accepted (needed to
send).

TenDlcChatInput.description: A question to the AI helper beside the form.

messages.description:
The conversation so far, oldest first, ending with the question
(the latest [`chat::MAX_TURNS`] are read).

draft.description: The form as it is on screen, unsaved edits included.

TenDlcCost.description: What Telnyx charges for a campaign.

upFrontCost.description:
Charged when the campaign is created (Telnyx's amount, US dollars,
e.g. `30.00`); null when Telnyx did not say.

monthlyCost.description:
Charged monthly after the first three months (US dollars); null when
Telnyx did not say.

description.description: Telnyx's note on the cost; null when none.

TenDlcDraft.description: The registration form: the business and how it texts.

TenDlcFeedback.description: One of Telnyx's (or a carrier's) reasons, phone numbers masked.

title.description: What it is about, e.g. "Tax Id", "Carrier review".

description.description: What is wrong, in Telnyx's words.

fields.description:
The form fields it names (Telnyx's names, e.g. `ein`, `sample1`);
may be empty.

registrations.description:
Those waiting for a superuser first (ready, rejected), then the
newest.

TenDlcListItem.description: One company's registration in the superusers' list.

displayName.description: The business name on the form; may be empty.

problemCount.description: What blocks sending it; 0 when complete.

brandStatus.description: Telnyx's brand status; null before sending.

lastError.description: What went wrong last; null when nothing.

readyAt.description: When a Manager last marked it ready; null when never.

readyByName.description: Who marked it ready; null when never.

sentAt.description: When it was first sent; null before.

TenDlcNumber.description: One of the company's active numbers and its campaign assignment.

label.description: Its label on the Phone page; may be empty.

status.description:
Telnyx's assignment status (`PENDING_ASSIGNMENT`, `ASSIGNED`,
`FAILED_ASSIGNMENT`, ...); null when never assigned.

error.description:
Why the assignment failed (Telnyx's words, numbers masked); null
when it did not.

updatedAt.description: When its assignment last changed; null when never assigned.

assigned.description: Numbers Telnyx took (assigned, or being assigned).

failed.description:
Numbers Telnyx refused or did not answer about (each one's `error`
says why; assign again to retry them).

skipped.description: Numbers assigned to the campaign already.

TenDlcProblem.description: What blocks marking the form ready or sending it.

field.description:
The field, as a path of the form: `brand.ein`, `campaign.samples.1`,
`campaign.subUsecases`.

message.description: What is wrong, for the person filling it in.

saved.description:
A registration is saved; false before the first save (`draft` is
then a suggestion).

status.description: Where it is (`draft` before the first save).

problems.description: What blocks marking it ready (or sending it); empty when complete.

campaignLocked.description:
Telnyx has the campaign: only its sample texts, message flow and
help message can change.

brandStatus.description:
Telnyx's brand status: `OK`, `REGISTRATION_PENDING` or
`REGISTRATION_FAILED`; null before sending.

brandIdentityStatus.description:
TCR's check of the business: `SELF_DECLARED`, `VERIFIED`,
`VETTED_VERIFIED` or `UNVERIFIED`; null before sending.

campaignStatus.description:
Telnyx's campaign status (`TCR_PENDING` ... `MNO_PROVISIONED`, or
`REFUSED` when Telnyx refused to create it); null before.

brandFeedback.description:
Why Telnyx refused the brand (its feedback), phone numbers masked;
empty when nothing is wrong.

campaignFeedback.description:
Why Telnyx or a carrier refused the campaign, phone numbers masked;
empty when nothing is wrong.

lastError.description:
What went wrong last on our side (Telnyx did not answer, ...); null
when nothing.

draftSavedAt.description: When the form was last saved; null before.

draftSavedByName.description: Who saved it last (name, else email); null when unknown.

readyAt.description: When it was last marked ready; null when never.

readyByName.description: Who marked it ready (name, else email); null when never.

sentAt.description: When it was first sent to Telnyx; null before.

approvedAt.description: When the carriers approved it; null before.

rejectedAt.description: When it was last refused; null when never.

oneOf.description:
The AI check that runs when a Manager marks it ready (the form and
the quote form, privacy policy and terms pages, as the carriers
check them): waiting, running, passed (it went to the superusers),
changes (what to change) or failed (it went on unchecked); null when
never asked for.

actions.description: What the company's Managers may do now.

appealReason.description:
For a campaign Telnyx or a carrier refused: what was fixed (on the
website, the opt-in page, ...), for Telnyx's compliance team to look
again (an appeal); up to 1000 characters. Null or empty: no appeal.

TenDlcReview.description: A company's registration as a superuser reviews it.

registration.description: The registration (`draft` is a suggestion while `saved` is false).

numbers.description: The company's active numbers and their assignments.

telnyxSetUp.description:
The company has a Telnyx setup (needed to send: its webhook token
names the company in Telnyx's notifications).

messagingProfileSet.description:
The company's Telnyx setup has a messaging profile (the numbers must
be on it to be assigned).

sentByName.description: Who first sent it (name, else email); null before.

resentAt.description: When it was last sent again; null when never.

refreshedAt.description: When it was last read from Telnyx; null when never.

actions.description: What the superuser may do now.

TenDlcReviewActions.description: What a superuser may do with the registration now.

send.description:
Send it to Telnyx the first time (`POST .../send`): complete, and
no brand yet.

resend.description:
Send it again after a rejection (`POST .../resend`): complete, and
Telnyx has the brand.

assignNumbers.description:
Assign the company's numbers to the approved campaign
(`POST .../numbers`).

brandId.description: Telnyx's brand id; null before sending.

tcrBrandId.description: TCR's brand id (`B...`); null until registered.

campaignId.description: Telnyx's campaign id; null until created.

tcrCampaignId.description: TCR's campaign id (`C...`); null until registered.

completed.description: The caller once answered every one of its questions right in one try.

TestReport.description: The agent's test, as it reported it.

files.description: Test files, relative to the target repository.

command.description: The command that runs it, e.g. `cargo test -p api --test sms tts_reply`.

why_not_possible.description: Why no automated test was possible.

manual_test_steps.description: How a person checks the fix by hand.

TestStatus.description: Whether the agent wrote a test.

TexmlRequest.description:
The fields of Telnyx's TeXML requests the callbacks read. Telnyx posts
them form-encoded; every field is optional and others are ignored.

AccountSid.description:
The Telnyx account; required, and must be the company's, when the
company saved its account id (`telnyxAccountId`).

CallSid.description: The call, or the leg, the request is about.

ConnectionId.description:
The Telnyx connection (the company's TeXML app); must be the
company's when it set one.

From.description: Who placed the call: E.164, or a SIP URI.

To.description: Who was called: E.164, or a SIP URI.

CallStatus.description:
The call's status: `initiated`, `ringing`, `in-progress`,
`completed`, `busy`, `no-answer`, `canceled` or `failed`; after an AI
Assistant that could not start, `conversation_start_failed`.

CallDuration.description: How long the call (or the leg) lasted, in seconds (0 to 86400).

DialCallDuration.description: How long that leg talked, in seconds (0 to 86400).

HangupCause.description: Why the call ended (Telnyx's hangup cause).

Reason.description: Why the AI Assistant's conversation ended or did not start.

Timestamp.description:
When it happened (RFC 3339 or RFC 2822); used as the time of an
answer or an end, held between the call's start and now.

CallerId.description:
The caller's display name, when the network gave one (Telnyx's
inbound call screening puts `SPAM LIKELY` there).

ShakenStirAttestation.description:
The caller-ID check's (STIR/SHAKEN) attestation, `A`, `B` or `C`,
when the TeXML app sends STIR/SHAKEN data.

ShakenStirValidated.description: Whether the caller-ID check passed (`true` / `false`), when sent.

TextCustomer.description: The customer the other number belongs to.

TextError.description:
Why a text failed: `opted_out` (the person texted STOP),
`invalid_number`, `carrier_rejected` or `failed` (anything else).

TextLast.description: The newest text of a thread.

text.description: Its text; empty for a picture or file alone.

at.description: When it was sent or received (RFC 3339).

TextMedia.description: A picture or file of a text.

id.description: Its id (`GET /v1/phone/texts/media/{id}` gives a link to it).

name.description: The file's name; null when unknown.

size.description: Its size in bytes; null when unknown.

id.description: Our id of the text (`before` when paging).

text.description: The text; empty for pictures or files alone.

media.description: Its pictures and files, in order.

oneOf.description: Why it failed; null unless `status` is `failed`.

at.description: When it was sent or received (RFC 3339).

sentBy.description: Who sent an outbound text; null for inbound and automated ones.

nextBefore.description: `before` for the next (older) page; null on the last.

id.description: The number's id (`ourNumberId` when texting from it).

label.description: Its label, e.g. "Main line"; may be empty.

TextStatus.description:
Where a text is: `queued` (Telnyx has it), `sent` (handed to the
carrier), `delivered`, `failed`, or `received` (an inbound text).

TextThread.description: A conversation of one of my lines with one other number.

key.description: Opaque and stable: our number and the other number.

oneOf.description: The customer with that number; null when none.

nextBefore.description: `before` for the next page; null on the last.

unread.description: My unread texts over all my threads.

Texting.description: The Texts tab's switch and badge.

enabled.description:
The company texts through Telnyx (its messaging profile is set and
calling is on): show the Texts tab.

unread.description: My unread texts (0 while texting is off).

id.description: Customer id, when the address belongs to one.

name.description: Customer, header or coworker name; the address, or `Customer`.

deal_id.description: Deal the conversation is on.

sending_email.description: The address the caller's mail leaves from (theirs, or the shared one).

messages.description: Messages, oldest first (on a deal: the deal's and unassigned ones).

participants.description: Addresses of every message, in header order (no BCC).

customer_addresses.description: Every address of the customer, primary first (empty when unknown).

thread_ids.description: Conversation ids (only the caller's own threads are changed).

unread_count.description: Unread threads (ignoring the search when it matches nothing).

body.description: Plain text body.

html_body.description: HTML body, when the mail had one.

sender_user_id.description: Sending user; null for mail from outside.

signature.description: Email signature of the sending user.

read_at.description: When the recipient last opened it.

phone_digits.description: The other party's phone (the thread key).

customer_name.description: The customer's name, else a supplier's.

last_message_text.description: Text of the latest message (a photo or file label when it has none).

last_message_at.description: When the latest message was sent.

last_agent.description: Agent id on the latest message.

message_count.description: Messages in the conversation (matching the search, with one).

unread_count.description: Unread messages (1 when marked unread by hand).

processed.description: Ledger rows this tick changed (the time-triggered Lambda logs it).

discovered.description: New bugs recorded (a bug is one signature of `$exception` events).

skipped.description: Bugs skipped as noise, resolved, suppressed or not production.

duplicates.description:
Browser errors folded into the API error of the same request, or
toasts into the web error they repeat.

previewed.description: Runs a dry run would have started (emailed instead).

timed_out.description: Runs given up by the watchdog.

assigned.description: PostHog issues of opened fixes assigned to their reviewer (write-back).

busy.description: Another tick held the lock; this one did nothing.

errors.description: Steps that failed (PostHog or GitHub unreachable); retried next tick.

TimeRules.description: How long one kind of job takes, and the work day it fits in.

per_sqft_minutes.description: Minutes per square foot of the sale.

per_cooktop_minutes.description: Minutes per room with a cooktop cutout.

per_backsplash_minutes.description: Minutes per room with a 4" backsplash.

per_full_backsplash_minutes.description: Minutes per room with a full-height backsplash.

per_tear_out_minutes.description: Minutes per room with a tear-out.

travel_minutes.description: Minutes kept free between two jobs of one person (driving).

day_start_minute.description: When the work day starts, in minutes after midnight (shop time).

day_end_minute.description: When it ends, in minutes after midnight (shop time).

kind.description: Which jobs these rules are for.

text.description: The text (an email starts with its subject line).

TopSoldStone.description: A stone the signed-in user sold slabs of this month.

slabs_sold.description: Full slabs sold (remnants cut from them are not counted again).

square_feet.description: Square feet of those slabs, decimal string; "0.00" when no slab has a size.

TransactionDetail.description: A transaction as its dialog shows it.

sf.description: Square feet (the shop view: each room's, added up).

call_id.description:
`CloudTalk`'s numeric call id, the `RingCentral` call id, or a
Granite Phone call `tx_<id>` (`Cdr.id` of `GET /v1/calls/telnyx`).

recording_link.description:
The call's `recording_link`: a `RingCentral` media token, a
`CloudTalk` URL, or the Granite Phone call `tx_<id>`.

TranscriptStatus.description:
The AI note's progress: `none` (not recorded or AI notes off),
`pending`, `processing`, `done`, `failed` or `skipped`.

UnpricedModel.description: A model with free-looking usage and no price.

Unread.description:
Unseen incoming calls of the last 30 days in a user's Recents, for the
badge.

missed.description: Unseen missed calls (nobody answered, no message left).

aiMessage.description: Unseen messages the AI Assistant took.

count.description: Unread inbox threads; 0 when the company has no inbound email.

latest_inbound_id.description: Newest unread message id, to notice new mail between polls.

monthly_sales_goal.description:
Goal for each month in USD, above 0 and below 10 billion; rounded to
cents.

UpdateSlab.description:
Body of `PATCH /v1/slabs/{id}`: the fields to change. Length and width
go together.

length.description: New length in inches; a positive number, decimals allowed.

width.description: New width in inches; a positive number, decimals allowed.

bundle.description: New bundle label (the slab number); not empty.

Upload.description: Where to upload, and the URL to give the record afterwards.

upload_url.description:
`PUT` the file body here (valid 15 minutes) with the `Content-Type`
given in the request.

url.description: Public URL of the file once uploaded; pass it to the record's route.

token.description:
`emails` only: proof the caller uploaded `url`; send it with the
attachment to `POST /v1/emails`.

UploadFolder.description: Where an upload goes; each record type takes files of its own folder.

folder.description: Folder of the record the file is for.

file_name.description: Original file name; only its extension is kept.

content_type.description:
MIME type of the file: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`,
`image/gif`, `image/heic` or `image/heif`; for `deals` and `documents` also PDF, Word,
Excel, CSV and plain text; for `supplier-files` also PDF, CSV, TSV and plain text; for `sms-uploads` also AVIF, Word, Excel, PDF,
CSV, plain text and `application/octet-stream` (a file the browser could
not type); for `emails` and `email-templates` any type. Send the same value
as the `Content-Type` header of the `PUT`.

features.description: Features with calls in the range, by key.

unpriced_models.description: Models used for free without a price row.

calls.description: The page of calls, newest first.

UseCase.description: What the texts are about (TCR's campaign use case).

id.description: Id of the row in its source.

deal_id.description: The deal.

summary.description: One line shown next to the action: email subject, activity name, ...

contact.description: Who it went to: an email address or phone number.

body.description: Longer text (capped), shown when the row is expanded.

tags.description: Labels: stage, amount, "Received", ...

name.description: Name (may stay empty while their invite is pending).

company_id.description: Superusers: move them to this company.

marketing_company_ids.description: External marketing: the companies they market for.

superadmin_company_ids.description: Superusers: the companies they are Super Admin of.

is_admin.description: Admin access (always on for Super Admins).

ringcentral_phone_number.description:
`RingCentral` number (10+ digits) or empty; the extension is looked up
from it.

superadmin_company_ids.description: Companies they are Super Admin of.

UserLimit.description: How many users a company has and may have.

current_count.description: Users counting toward the limit (check-in-only accounts do not).

UserNameRow.description: A user's id and display name.

company_id.description: The company listed; null for every company (superusers).

user_limits.description: Each pickable company's user count and limit.

Verification.description: What the workflow proved about the agent's commits.

to.description: The number to call, US or Canada (E.164 or 10 digits).

callerNumberId.description:
The caller ID the customer sees (one of my caller IDs); null = my
default.

customerId.description:
The customer being called, when known; ignored unless a customer of
my company (the number's customer is used then).

ViewGate.description: Whether the visitor may see the page, and where a code would go.

verified.description: The visitor entered a code for this page (valid for 7 days).

has_email.description: The customer has an email a code can go to.

code_sent.description: A code was sent and has not expired.

ViewProject.description: One of the customer's projects (a sale).

WaitingCustomer.description: A customer whose text waits for the caller's reply.

customer_id.description: The customer with that phone; null when it is on no customer.

deviceName.description:
Shown in "Signed-in devices", e.g. "Chrome on Windows" (cut to 100
characters; empty = "Browser").

id.description:
The browser's phone device: send it as the `X-Granite-Device-Id` SIP
header of every call, and use it in `/v1/phone/web/devices/{id}/...`.

serverTime.description: Our clock now (RFC 3339), to sign calls with.

Our clock now (RFC 3339): the browser signs its calls with our time,
so a wrong computer clock does not get them refused.

callingEnabled.description:
The browser can call and ring: the company's calling is on, with its
credential connection set. False: show "calling is off".

recordingMode.description: Which calls the company records: `off`, `inbound` or `both`.

callerIds.description:
The numbers the user may call from (direct lines first); empty: the
user cannot call.

defaultNumberId.description:
The caller ID calls use unless another is picked: the user's default
while it is theirs, else their first direct line, else the first.

settings.description: The user's phone settings (the verified cell for Call via my cell).

availability.description: Whether calls ring the user now (Do not disturb, working hours).

online.description:
True: the tab is connected to Telnyx and rings (for the next 150
seconds; say it again every minute). False: it stops ringing at once.

WeekStart.description: The first day of a week.

WidgetAction.description: What a user did with a widget.

top_used.description: Uses per user, widget and target, most first.

current_widgets.description: Every user's dashboard widgets, by company, user and position.

WidgetEvent.description: One use of a dashboard widget, for product analytics.

target.description:
What in the widget was used, e.g. `quick-links` or `sales-goal`;
1 to 64 characters after trimming.

saved.description:
The layout this browser saved for the company, as the page stored it;
null when none.

hidden_by_default.description:
The company starts with an empty board (new companies) instead of the
default widgets.

WidgetUse.description: How often users clicked or changed something on a widget.

WorkingDay.description: One time range of a weekday.

end.description:
Local end, `HH:MM`, after `start`; `24:00` = midnight at the end of
the day.

WorkingHours.description:
When a user takes calls (null in the API: always). Outside these hours
their phones do not ring; calls go to the number's fallback and still
show in Recents.

tz.description: IANA time zone the hours are in, e.g. `America/Indiana/Indianapolis`.

days.description:
The time ranges, any number per weekday (at most 28 in all, at least
one); a weekday without a range is a day off.

autofix_callback.description: `POSTHOG_AUTOFIX_CALLBACK_SECRET`, sent by the posthog-autofix GitHub workflow.

device_token.name: X-Granite-Device
device_token.description: Device token of a signed-in Granite Phone app (`POST /v1/auth/device-sessions`).

session_cookie.name: __session
session_cookie.description: Signed React Router session cookie set by the Granite Manager login.
